title: An export that leaves out its last receipt
additional: Beyond the ten core cases; it shows what the manifest is for.
change: chain.jsonl leaves out the period's last receipt (86, sha256:103f6bbd70e0048776e6089e68d18feb4557b07aee2ab65966075c2492b41dad, signed billable), and bill.json leaves it out too (its line's quantity and amount lowered to match). The manifest is the real one.
why: Every remaining receipt verifies and links, and the bill matches the export exactly, so a consumer without the manifest would pass it. The signed manifest's count, last sequence, head and root show that a receipt is missing.
